A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same adaptive-canonicalization work. All 38 pages of v2 and 44 pages of v3, including appendices, are readable; relocated text, equations, tables and figures can be matched reliably.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix G report original classification, segmentation, ablation and training-stability results.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix H retain original experimental results, including graph classification, point-cloud classification and ShapeNet segmentation.

M1.justification: Appendix A.4 adds an optional adaptation that canonicalizes internal Vector Neuron features before downstream classification; v2 E.4 describes input-coordinate canonicalization. This extension is not experimentally evaluated. The central prior-maximization procedure and segmentation adaptation are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same toy grids, TUDataset and OGB benchmarks, ModelNet40, CIFAR-10/100 with ImageNet pretraining, and ShapeNet Part. The z/SO(3) rotation-shift scenario is also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is retained within corresponding experiments, including FA/OAP graph baselines, VN/CN point-cloud baselines and the vanilla image classifier. Updated citation years and publication details do not introduce additional evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The reported spectral band-size rule changes from dataset-maximum sizes with padding in v2 E.3 to configurable J_k sizes with padding or truncation in v3 A.3. This revises the documented configuration without establishing that experiments were rerun. Benchmark splits, metrics and training budgets otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The sampling/refinement comparison, node-to-graph analysis, rotation-shift test, band/GSO/backbone ablations, sensitivity analyses and stability visualizations are retained. The backbone ablation moves from G.4.3 to H.5.1 without new evidence.

E5.justification: Repeated-run and uncertainty reporting remain unchanged, including ten random TUDataset splits with means and standard deviations and ten independent CIFAR runs. No new seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests appear.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables retain their numerical entries, including AC-DGCNN's 91.6±0.6 ModelNet40 accuracy in Table 3 and 80.9±0.7 ShapeNet score in Table 13. The plotted trends and reported qualitative findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.5 adds affine dilation to the formal crop transformation and supplies a finite-transformation continuity argument; resizing already existed in v2's implementation. Section 4.2 corrects the variable-size point-cloud group from S_N to SO(3). Definition 21 and Lemma 22 are retained through relocation from E.2 to Appendix E.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central contributions: network-dependent canonicalization, continuity and universal-approximation guarantees, graph and point-cloud applications, and empirical advantages over competing symmetry-handling approaches.

C2.justification: Appendix A.4 adds a rationale for canonicalizing learned vector features when early layers provide more stable directions. Section 6 qualifies the unaddressed regression limitation as theoretical. Existing result interpretations and the segmentation-continuity caveat remain.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-access statement, explicitly discusses precomputing spectral coefficients, expands the DGCNN construction and corrects Algorithm 1's function arguments. However, the earlier explicit dataset-maximum band-size rule is replaced by hyperparameters without reporting their selected values.

R1.justification: New Appendix B.4 discusses data augmentation and contrasts its distributional effects with class-dependent canonicalization, adding references such as AugMix, mixup and LieAugmenter. B.1 adds further spectral-representation citations. The principal novelty positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The application tutorial is substantially rewritten and moved from Appendix E to Appendix A. Theoretical appendices are reordered, sampling analysis receives a separate appendix, and contents, ethics, reproducibility and language-model-use sections are added. The main narrative receives lighter editing.

P2.justification: Document-wide ICLR formatting changes the title, abstract, typography, margins and running headers. Existing displays are resized and reflowed, including Table 10 and Figure 3 beside surrounding text, and appendix contents pages are added. All thirteen tables and four figures are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves organization, expands implementation explanations and adds a code link, but introduces technical inconsistencies. A.3's new efficient formula uses C_k U_k despite dimensions requiring multiplication on the left. A.5 adds crop dilation while retaining zero-area windows, leaving its continuity claim unjustified at those boundaries. These technical regressions coexist with useful presentation and documentation gains, making the net quality change unclear.
